grammar.title: 现实情况
lines: 8 But even in the most favourable circumstances only a small fraction of the creatures that die are preserved in this way before decay sets in or , even more likely, before scavengers eat them. circumstances 条件；环境；状况 fraction n. a small amount of sth. …的一小部分 set in if sth. sets in, especially sth. unpleasant, it begins and seems likely to continue for a long time （不愉快的事物）开始并可能继续下去 After all , all living creatures live by feeding on something else , whether it be plant or animal, dead or alive, and it is only by chance that such a fate is avoided. live by doing sth. live by means of doing sth.靠某种职业为生 whether it be... 让步状语从句中的虚拟语气 After all, all living creatures live by feeding on something else, be it plant or animal, dead or alive, and it is only by chance that such a fate is avoided. by chance 偶然地(随便地、意外地) The remains of plants and animals that lived on land are much more rarely preserved , for there is seldom anything to cover them over . cover sth. ⇔ over to put sth. on top of sth. else so that it is completely hidden (over 完全的) 覆盖住 When you think of the innumerable birds that one sees flying about , not to mention the equally numerous small animals l ike field mice and voles which you do not see , it is very rarely that one comes across a dead body, except, of course, on the roads . innumerable / numerous / countless 无数的；数量众多的 let alone 更不用说 Gre写作范文 come across = encounter v. 英文解释：If you come across sth. or sb., you find them or meet them by chance. 偶遇，邂逅 prep. + 介词短语做宾语 副词和介词短语都可以作介词的宾语 They decompose and are quickly destroyed by the weather or eaten by some other creature .
It is almost always due to some very special circumstances that traces of and animals survive, … 本文
A man without an education, many of us believe, is an unfortunate victim of adverse circumstances , deprived of one of the greatest twentieth-century opportunities .
Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked.
favourable circumstances 有利的条件 The project succeeded because of favourable circumstances in the market. 该项目的成功得益于市场中有利的条件。
adverse / unfavorable circumstances 不利的条件 He managed to finish the race despite adverse circumstances . 尽管条件不利，他还是坚持跑完了比赛。
exceptional / special / unusual circumstances 例外的条件 The school will close only in exceptional circumstances . 学校仅在例外情况下才会关闭。
unavoidable / unforeseen circumstances 无法避免的情况 The concert was cancelled due to unforeseen circumstances . 由于无法预见的情况，音乐会被取消了。
economic / financial / political / social circumstances …状况 Her financial circumstances improved after she got the promotion. 升职后，她的财务状况得到了改善。
in / under … circumstances 在…的情况下 Under no circumstances should you leave the door unlocked. 在任何情况下你都不应该不锁门。
due to … circumstances 由于…情况 The delay was due to circumstances beyond our control. 延误是由于我们无法控制的情况造成的。
We owe a lot to the birds and beasts who eat insects but all of them put together kill only a fraction of the number destroyed by spiders .
His shares are now worth a fraction of their former value.
A mere fraction of available wind energy is currently utilized.

a fraction of … ……的一小部分 The plastic can be recycled for a fraction of the cost of making new material. 这种塑料的回收成本仅为制造新材料成本的一小部分。 Although sexual and violent crimes have increased by 10%, they remain only a tiny fraction of the total number of crimes committed each year.

a small / tiny / mere fraction of … 极小的一部分 Only a tiny fraction of the population can afford such luxury. 只有极少数人能负担得起这种奢侈品。 Only a small fraction of a bank's total deposits will be withdrawn at any one time.

proportion / percentage 一部分；比例 The proportion of women in the engineering field is increasing. 工程领域中女性的比例正在增加。 Only a small percentage of the land is fertile. 只有一小部分土地是肥沃的。 We are lucky in that only the lower fields, which make up a very small proportion of our farm, are effected by flooding , …
a high / large proportion / percentage of … 一大部分 A large proportion of the company's profit comes from international sales. 公司的大部分利润来自国际销售。
a small / tiny proportion / percentage of … 一小部分 Only a small percentage of local residents voted in the last election. 在上一次选举中，只有一小部分当地居民参与了投票。
Further economic decline set in during the 1930s. 经济衰退在1930年代开始。
Despair seems to have set in among the team. 绝望似乎已经在团队中蔓延。
A cold winter set in early this year. 今年寒冬提前开始。
It has been said that everyone lives by selling something .
The nomads who made these markings lived by hunting and fishing during the last Ice Age which began about 35,000 B.C. and ended about 10,000 B.C .
He lives by writing . 他靠写作为生。
They live by hunting and fishing . 他们靠打猎捕鱼为生。
She lives by teaching . 她靠教书为生。

live sth. live according to … 按照……生活 I have always tried to live by my faith. We still do; living in a world in which undeclared aggression, war, hypocrisy, chicanery, anarchy and impending immolation are part of our daily lives, we all want a code to live by .
live on sth. 靠某种事物维生 He lives on meat and milk. 他靠肉和牛奶为生。 He lives on salary. He lives on his parents. 啃老

feed on sth. 以……为主食 Cows feed on hay. 奶牛以干草为食。 It has been found that certain bats emit squeaks and by receiving the echoes, they can locate and steer clear of obstacles—or locate flying insects on which they feed .
prey on sth. 捕食 Owls prey on mice. 猫头鹰以老鼠为食。
Whether it be bird, fish or beast, the porpoise is intrigued . ⇒ Be it bird, fish or beast, the porpoise is intrigued with anything that is alive.
Though he be the President, he shall listen to us. 即使他是总统，他也要听我们说。 ⇒ Be he the President himself, he shall listen to us.
Be they administrators or teachers, they are under pressure. 不管是行政人员还是教师，他们都承受压力。
Once the educators, be they administrators or teachers, are under the control of students, even a democratic situation would be like holding royalty accountable to the mob. Gre写作范文
We met by chance in Paris. 我们在巴黎偶然相遇。
I met an old friend at the airport by chance . 我在机场偶然遇到了一位老朋友。
The discovery happened by chance . 这个发现是偶然发生的。
He avoided disaster by chance . 他侥幸避免了灾难。
on purpose 故意地 I'm sorry, I didn't break the glass on purpose . 对不起，我不是故意打碎玻璃的。
by accident 意外地；不小心 The discovery was made quite by accident . 这个发现完全是意外获得的。
intentionally 有意地 He intentionally ignored my phone calls all day. 他整天故意不接我的电话。
accidentally 意外地；偶然地 I accidentally deleted the important file. 我不小心删除了那个重要文件。
deliberately 故意地；从容地 She deliberately kept the news from us. 她故意瞒着我们那个消息。
The female lays a single egg and covers it over . 雌鸟下一个蛋并将其盖住。
Snow covered over the entire village. 雪覆盖了整个村庄。
He quickly covered over the hole with a board. 他迅速用木板盖住洞。
Innumerable stars filled the sky. 无数星星布满天空。
We have numerous reasons to believe her. 我们有很多理由相信她。
There are countless books on the topic. 关于这个话题的书多得数不清。
innumerable 无数的，数不清的 The stars in the sky are innumerable . 天空中的繁星多得数不清。
numerous 许多的，众多的 He has been to numerous countries in Europe. 他去过欧洲的许多国家。
countless 无数的 I've told him countless times to close the window. 我告诉过他无数次要关窗户。
a host of … 许多，大量 The new law creates a host of problems for small businesses. 新法律给小企业带来了许多问题。
a mass of … 大量的，一大堆 There was a mass of documents waiting on his desk. 他桌上有大堆的文件等着处理。
a great many … 很多，许多 A great many people believe that the economy will improve soon. 许多人相信经济很快就会好转。
a large number of … 大量的 A large number of students applied for the scholarship. 大量的学生申请了这项奖学金。
I can’t afford a bike, let alone a car. 我连自行车都买不起，更不用说汽车了。
She can barely walk, let alone run. 她几乎走不动，更别说跑了。
They don’t have enough food, let alone medical supplies. 他们连吃的都不够，更不用说医疗用品了。
let alone … 更不用说… （可接各种词性）（用于否定句） He can't even ride a bicycle, let alone drive a car. 他连自行车都不会骑，更不用说开车了。
not to mention … 更不用说；且不说 （只能接名词或宾语从句）（用于肯定句） The house is beautiful and spacious, not to mention its great location. 这房子既漂亮又宽敞，更不用说它极佳的地理位置了。
The baby can’t talk, let alone run.
He can’t run a hundred yards, let alone a mile.
I don’t suspect him of theft, let alone of robbery.
They own two houses, not to mention a yacht.
The dampness is unpleasant, not to mention the cold.

Similarly, our own present primitive chemical rockets, though good enough to orbit men, have no chance of transporting us to the nearest other star, four light years away, let alone distances of tens or hundreds of light years.

In short, without better evidence that the survey is statistically reliable the chairperson cannot rely on it to draw any firm conclusion about the overall recycling commitment of West Egg residents （介词短语） — let alone about how quickly the landfill will reach capacity （介词短语） .
Moreover, the author has not shown any correlation （名词） , let alone a cause-and-effect relationship （名词） , between the number of hours a person spends watching television and that industry's profits.

Without ruling out all other possible explanations for the grade-average increase, the dean cannot convince me that by terminating the evaluation procedure Omega would curb its perceived grade inflation （动词） , let alone help its graduates get jobs （动词） .

In short, without ruling out other possible reasons for the strong sales the vice president cannot convince me that Plainsville residents are exercising regularly （宾语从句） , let alone that they would be interested in buying the sorts of food and other products that NW sells （宾语从句） .

much less / still less = let alone 更不用说… （可接各种词性）（用于否定句） Tony can barely boil an egg, much less cook dinner. I've never seen the man, much less spoken to him. No living person seemed to notice him, still less to like him.
to say nothing of = not to mention （只能接名词或名词短语）（用于肯定句） It would be an enormous amount of work, to say nothing of the cost. We will need more time, to say nothing of money.
I came across a group of children playing.
I come across this old photograph while cleaning the attic. 我在打扫阁楼时偶然发现了这张旧照片。
encounter 遭遇；遇到（困难、危险或陌生人） The expedition encountered many difficulties in the jungle. 探险队在丛林中遭遇了许多困难。
Staff are not permitted to make personal phone calls except in an emergency .
The weather has been fine except in the north .
The store is open every day from 9:00 to 5:00, except on Sundays .
They decompose and are quickly destroyed by the weather or (are) eaten by some other creature.
它们腐败 并列 很快就被风化掉 并列 被别的动物吃掉了

sentences.title: 结论
lines: 3 It is almost always due to some very special circumstances that traces of land animals survive , as by falling into inaccessible caves, or into an ice crevasse, like the Siberian mammoths , when the whole animal is sometimes preserved , as in a refrigerator. as (省略句) 作为方式状语从句 It is almost always due to some very special circumstances that traces of land animals survive , as (traces of land animals survive) by falling into inaccessible caves, or into an ice crevasse, like the Siberian mammoths, when the whole animal is sometimes preserved , as (the whole animal is preserved) in a refrigerator. 内容补全 crevasse n.deep open crack in the ice of a glacier （冰川的）裂缝 mammoth n.an animal similar to an elephant with long hair that lived a very long time ago 猛犸象 This is what happened to the famous Beresovka mammoth which was found preserved and in good condition . 表语从句 解释主语内容 In his mouth were the remains of fir trees -- the last meal that he had before he fell into the crevasse and broke his back . 表系主(主语太长，全部倒装) The remains of fir trees ― the last meal that he had before he fell into the crevasse and broke his back ― were in his mouth. 没有必要用圆周句、掉尾句 全部倒装 谓语提前使句式更强调(在主语较长时，常使用 表语 + 系动词 + 主语 的倒装结构。) The mammoth has now been restored in the Palaeontological Museum in St. Petersburg . restore 修复 Other animals were trapped in tar pits , like the elephants , sabre-toothed cats , and numerous other creatures that are found at Rancho la Brea , which is now just a suburb of Los Angeles . trap v.to prevent sb. from leaving a place, especially a dangerous place 使困在某处;困住 tar pit an accumulation of natura tar at the earth’s surface, especial one that acts as a trap for animals and preserves their bones 沥青坑：地表中天然沥青的集聚场所，尤指使动物不慎陷入其中并保存了它们的骨骼的天然沥青聚集点 saber-toothed cat / sabre-toothed cat (42 million years ago ~ 11,000 years ago) A saber-toothed cat , also called saber-toothed tiger , is any member of various extinct groups of predatory mammals that were characterized by long, curved saber-shaped canine teeth. The large maxillary canine teeth extended from the mouth even when it was closed. Apparently what happened was that water collected on these tar pits, and the bigger animals like the elephants ventured out on to the apparently firm surface to drink, and were promptly bogged in the tar . collect v.if a substance collects somewhere, it gradually goes there（ 物体）聚集 bog v.to make sth. sink into mud or wet ground（使某物）陷入泥沼 And then , when they were dead , the carnivores, like the sabretoothed cats and the giant wolves, came out to feed and suffered exactly the same fate . suffer a ... fate 遭遇...命运 giant wolf / dire wolf n. a large wolf-like mammal that inhabited North America during the Pleistocene epoch (2,000,000 years ago ~10,000 years ago) 恐狼 There are also endless numbers of birds in the tar as well . also ... as well 语义重复（Redundancy） 也有…而且也是；又…且也 每日习语 The higher you go, the further you see. 站得越高，看得远。
The fossils are sometimes preserved, as in ice caves. 正如在冰洞中一样
They behave as expected. 他们如预期般行事
The child reacted as his mother would. 这孩子像他母亲一样反应
The climber fell into a crevasse . 登山者掉进了冰川裂缝
They crossed a dangerous crevasse . 他们穿越了一条危险的冰缝
Snow hid the deep crevasse . 雪覆盖了深深的裂缝
The mammoth lived thousands of years ago. 猛犸象生活在几千年前
A frozen mammoth was discovered. 一只冻住的猛犸象被发现
Mammoth bones were unearthed. 猛犸象骨骼被挖掘出土
This is what I meant. 这就是我想说的
That was what he experienced. 那就是他所经历的
Here is what they discovered. 这是他们发现的内容
Gone are the days of innocence. 天真无邪的日子一去不返
Gone are the days when my heart was young and gay.
On the floor were toys and clothes. 地板上散落着玩具和衣服
On the floor were piles of books, magazines and newspapers.
Happy is the man who learns from failure. 能从失败中学习的人是幸福的
Happy is he who has a sound mind in a sound body.
The painting was restored to its original state. 这幅画被恢复成原来的样子
The old car has been restored . 这辆旧车已被修复
The museum restored the ancient artifacts. 博物馆修复了古代文物
Miners were trapped underground. 矿工被困在地下
He was trapped in a burning car. 他被困在燃烧的车中
The tourists were trapped by the flood. 游客被洪水困住了
Dozens of people were trapped in the rubble when the building collapsed.
There's no way out! We're trapped !
After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick, they found that a man had been trapped in the chimney .
The fossil was found in a tar pit . 化石在沥青坑中被发现
Tar pits can preserve bones. 沥青坑可以保存骨骼
Many ancient animals were trapped in tar pits . 许多古动物被困在沥青坑中
sabre-toothed cat 剑齿虎 The sabre-toothed cat hunted large prey. 剑齿虎捕食大型猎物
Rain collected in the bucket. 雨水聚集在桶中
Water collected at the bottom of the pit. 水聚集在坑底
Snow collected on the branches. 雪积在树枝上
The jeep was bogged down in mud. 吉普陷入了泥中
The tank got bogged down in mud.
They got bogged during the hike. 他们在徒步中陷入泥地
The tank bogged in the wet field. 坦克陷入湿地
bog n. 沼泽 A piece of impassable bog with yield of liquid peat. 一个不可逾越的泥沼区。
They suffered the same fate as their ancestors. 他们遭遇了和祖先一样的命运
The animals suffered a cruel fate . 这些动物遭遇了残酷命运
The whole village suffered a tragic fate . 整个村庄遭遇了悲惨的命运
The refugees have suffered an appalling fate.
The Casino, where she had often danced, had suffered a similar fate.
The disciples were terrified that they would suffer the same fate as Jesus.
The Dire Wolf is a pack fighter that benefits when it has other wolfallies around. 惧狼是成群结队的攻击者，当有其他同盟的狼在附近时可以得到一些好处。
They include the endangered Mexican Wolf and giant Saguaro cactus. 包括了濒危的墨西哥狼和巨大的萨挂诺仙人掌。
giant wolf 恐狼 The giant wolf roamed North America. 恐狼曾在北美漫游
She not only bought a new car, but she also bought a luxury house as well . 她不仅买了一辆新车，甚至还买了一套豪宅。【强调范围之广（强调包含关系）】
The teachers were tired after the school trip, and the students were also exhausted as well . 学校旅行结束后老师们很累，而学生们其实也一样疲惫不堪。【强调参与者之多】
He is a talented musician, and he also happens to be a professional athlete as well . 他是个有才华的音乐家，而且同时竟然也是一名职业运动员。【强调额外的信息（多重叠加）】
保留 Also There are also endless numbers of birds in the tar. 最常见的陈述方式。
保留 As well There are endless numbers of birds in the tar as well . 语气稍微轻快一些。
保留 Too There are endless numbers of birds in the tar, too . 比较口语化。
